Date: Sun, 30 May 2027 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: BrightLens onboarding - initial context & traffic questions

Hi Jonas,

Thanks again for the quick turnaround on the onboarding timeline. We kicked off internally this morning and I wanted to surface two items so we can make the kickoff productive:

1) Context characteristics: our use case is a hybrid of long-form customer support threads (~10–25k characters) and structured product event records (compact, 200–800 characters). We estimate ~30% long-form vs 70% short-form prompts.

2) Expected token volume: our initial projection is ~450k users/month with an average of ~6 prompts per active user. Prompt+response average token estimate is roughly 1,200 tokens for long-form sessions and 120 tokens for short-form sessions. Rough blended estimate today is ~360M tokens/month. We understand these are early numbers.

For the kickoff we want to validate model choices (context length options: 8k/16k/32k), and get your recommended shortlist and an initial sizing plan so we can align procurement and network access.

Attached are a small sample of anonymized threads and a CSV export of event records. Can you confirm what additional artifacts you need before the kickoff call? Also propose 30-minute slots Tuesday/Wednesday PST.

Thanks,
Olivia Grant
Head of Technical Product
BrightLens Analytics

Attachments: brightlens_sample_documents.zip (sample threads + event CSV)
From: jonas.weber@redwood.ai <jonas.weber@redwood.ai>

Hi Olivia — thanks for the details and the sample data. This is great.

Quick answers up front and then a suggested next step:

- Recommended shortlist (initial):
  * Redwood-3-13B-fp16 — strong latency/cost balance for short-form and structured events (8k context).
  * Open-70B-chat-q4_1 — for higher-fidelity long-form conversation handling (16k context).
  * LlamaX-Server-32k — fallback / high-context path for the 25k char threads (32k context).

- Sizing back-of-envelope (blended):
  * If blended tokens are ~360M/month, with 70% short (120 tokens) and 30% long (1,200 tokens): expected p95 concurrent token/sec ~ 220–320 tokens/s depending on diurnal distribution.
  * For production safety we recommend reserving enough Dedicated capacity to sustain 600 tokens/s burst capacity and autoscale from 150 tokens/s baseline.

Questions for you:
- Can you confirm percent of traffic that requires strict PII redaction at request time vs post-processing? That affects routing and private deployment needs.
- Do you expect synchronous SLAs (sub-1s) for short-form responses, or is 1–2s acceptable?

Next step: I'd like to present this shortlist and a simple capacity sketch on our kickoff call. Proposed slots: Tue 2027-06-01 10:00–10:30 PT or Wed 2027-06-02 09:00–09:30 PT. Which works?

I'm attaching a quick worksheet (BL-kickoff-qa.xlsx) that we can use to lock in final token assumptions during the call.

Cheers,
Jonas Weber
Solutions Architect, Customer Success
Redwood Inference

Attachments: BL-kickoff-qa.xlsx

Team — forwarding BrightLens initial ask. High level summary and proposed action items below.

Summary (from my reply to BrightLens):
- They have a hybrid workload: ~30% long-form (large threads) and ~70% short-form event-driven prompts. Blended ~360M tokens/month by their early projection.
- Want validation on model choices and context-length options (8k / 16k / 32k).

My proposed model path and rationale:
- Path A (cost-optimized): Redwood-3-13B-fp16 (8k) + caching for repeated event templates. Good latency and cost per token for the 70% short-form workload.
- Path B (balanced fidelity): Open-70B-chat-q4_1 (16k) for better long-form coherence; keep aggressive batching for short-form.
- Path C (high-context): LlamaX-Server-32k reserved for sessions that require full thread context (25k char equivalents). Enable on-demand routing and fallback.

Initial capacity estimate (conservative):
- Baseline dedicated footprint to reserve: 2 x A100-class GPUs (or equivalent instances) to cover sustained 150 tokens/s baseline for Path A + background jobs.
- Burst/Autoscale headroom: additional 2 GPUs available for spikes to reach ~600 tokens/s.
- Estimated monthly cost delta (very rough): $18–28k for baseline reserved + variable usage. We'll refine after we lock token assumptions.

Operational asks (who owns what):
- Monica (CS): please coordinate kickoff scheduling with BrightLens, collect final sample prompt sets, and confirm PII/redaction requirements.
- Grace (Model Ops): please pre-validate Redwood-3-13B-fp16 and Open-70B-chat-q4_1 on our dedicated staging cluster for their token-length distributions; flag any memory/kv-cache concerns.
- Vivek (Infra): please provision two GPU units in us-west-2 as a baseline reservation and enable autoscale policy skeleton for the burst demands.
- Lauren (PM): capture the proposed milestones and procurement dependencies in the onboarding playbook; add a DocuSign link for the Dedicated reservation addendum if they request reserved capacity.

Attachments: redwood_model_shortlist_recs.pdf (shortlist + technical notes), BL-kickoff-qa.xlsx (worksheet already sent to customer).

Proposed timeline: kickoff call Wed 2027-06-02, sizing worksheet filled in during the call, followed by a 1-week technical validation sprint.

Please reply with any immediate blockers. If no objections by EOD Tuesday I'll lock the Wed slot and send the invite + prep doc.

Thanks,
Jonas
